DM bottleneck

Your bio still says DM

Your offers have their own pages, but the call to action in your bio is "DM", so the front door still runs through you. Each message has to be answered, qualified and followed up by hand, one woman at a time.

Content treadmill

1,696 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post. When you step back to rest, which is part of what you teach, the flow of new women steps back too.

Proof stays hidden

8 years and 5K+ lives in one bio line

Your experience is real, but a new follower only sees it as a line of text. Between events, nothing walks her through your approach before she decides to reach out.

The women who love your content but aren't ready for Her Table today can only say a small yes when the next event goes on sale, so between events most of them say nothing.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass on magnetic leadership, with a toolkit straight after checkout

You already have the audience, the experience and the trust. What's missing is one evergreen 60-minute class that shows women how you help them reclaim their magnetism and lead with confidence, a low-ticket toolkit on the thank-you page, and an invitation to apply on the replay. A small paid seat brings in women who are committed enough to show up, Meta ads put the class in front of new women every day, and the seat and toolkit sales help fund the ads.

Sound familiar?

You're capable, caring and good at what you do. So why does confidence still feel out of reach?

  • You're a woman who holds back in the room, then replays what you could have said all evening.
  • You give and give at work and at home, and end the week drained instead of magnetic.
  • You've been told to lead "like a man", and it has never felt like you.
  • You're ready to be seen, heard and respected, without forcing it or becoming someone else.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

01

Why capable women shrink

The patterns that keep smart, caring women playing small, and how to notice them as they happen.

Where magnetism comes from

Why magnetism is a way of being you can practise, not a personality you either have or don't.

03

Leading from your feminine strengths

How to lead with warmth, intuition and presence instead of copying a style that was never yours.

04

Your voice and your boundaries

Simple ways to speak up, say no and ask for what you want, calmly and clearly.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The replay in your head"

Hook
"If you've ever left a meeting and spent the whole evening replaying what you should have said, this is for you." (to camera, outdoors in golden light, same feel as your profile photo)
Body
"So many capable women hold back, not because they have nothing to say, but because they learned that being smaller felt safer. Confidence doesn't come from forcing it. It comes from feeling at home in yourself, and that can be practised." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA

Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before you walk in"

Hook
"Before your next big conversation, ask yourself these three questions." (Mariana holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: how do I want to feel when I leave this room? Two: what is the one thing I really want to say? Three: where in my body do I feel steady right now?" (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go much deeper on this in my $17 live class, The Magnetic Leader. Link below."
